# Goal
Kagi round 22 only. Axes: calibration and freshness. Frozen base c2cab35bc92e57e39e5489bac3386db078345b3f. C1 calibration: feature-specific source/status/eligibility/product adjudication must reject the known E1/E3 overclaims and admit correctly bounded controls; measure correct decisions, NOT authored row counts. C2 freshness: reconcile stale revision stamps and the nine previously dropped stamps without silent deletion or laundering; document ledger expectation migrations with exact historic evidence. No depth move or legacy-header count claim.
# Contract
Every Report: trailer is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin; write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/<that path>. You may write ONLY your report and, if explicitly a writer, your private clone under /tmp/kagi-r22-<seat>; one integration owner is KagiR22. Never write production files, live lane jj state/Git index, fleet repo, sibling repos, config/state, host configuration. Read-only seats return findings and own report. No live vault/account/credential operations, secrets, package transactions, services or boot changes; fixtures/local corpus only. No delegation. Skip builds/lint/tests/formatters mid-flight; name checks parent should run after integration; explicitly assigned research commands are allowed. Read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md before installations; pacman transactions PAUSED host-wide; only approved uv tools/official binaries/npm, never pacman -Sy or remote scripts. Record installs tool/version/channel/reason. No model parameters. Parent retains planner seat. Reports state evidence, limits, proposed correction and exact read revision. Research source quotes <=25 words each with heading and URL/date. Never copy vendor example credentials or secret-reference URIs.
milestone: Build source-bound calibration and pin-debt reconciliation
